meta.name: react-expert
meta.description: Use when building React 18+ applications in .jsx or .tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Creates components, implements custom hooks, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and implements state management. Invoke for Server Components, Suspense boundaries, useActionState forms, performance optimization, or React 19 features.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你编写 React 组件、自定义 Hook、调试渲染问题、将类组件转为函数组件，并实现状态管理。它还会处理 React 19 的 Server Components、Suspense 边界和表单。
howto.when: 当你在 .jsx 或 .tsx 文件中构建 React 18+ 应用、使用 Next.js App Router 或 create-react-app 时触发。也适用于 Server Components、Suspense、useActionState 表单或性能优化。

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 19 的 useActionState 表单。
把这个类组件迁移成函数组件。
say.note: Claude 会转换并添加 hooks。

say.text: 优化这个列表组件的渲染性能。
say.note: Claude 会应用 memo 和 key 优化。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you write React components, custom hooks, debug rendering issues, migrate class components to functional ones, and implement state management. It also handles React 19 Server Components, Suspense boundaries, and forms.
howto.when_en: Triggered when building React 18+ apps in .jsx/.tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Also for Server Components, Suspense, useActionState forms, or performance optimization.

say_en.text: Write a React 19 useActionState form for me.
say_en.note: Claude generates a form component with TypeScript types.

say_en.text: Migrate this class component to a functional one.
say_en.note: Claude converts it and adds hooks.

say_en.text: Optimize the rendering performance of this list component.
say_en.note: Claude applies memo and key optimizations.
